column1: # Descriptive renames of address-named sources (readability pass).
# One rename per line: <old path as in the reference><TAB><new path>. readable_check.py accepts a spec
# whose src lines differ from the reference only by these renames (function set and addresses are still
# compared with the old file); objcmp.py compares the new file with the old one. Spec names stay.
# Add the entry in the same commit as the git mv and the src-line change; never chains or duplicates.
